criteria: Keep standard as main parser if its arithmetic mean data-cell accuracy across nine grid tables is at most 0.05 below VLM.
List each table where VLM data-cell accuracy is at least 0.10 above standard.
parser-comparison.primary_standard: corpus_fast; corpus_accurate evaluated separately against the same criterion
parser-comparison.model: MinerU2.5-Pro-2604-1.2B Q8_0, existing f16 projector, loopback only
parser-comparison.coverage: Union of all table-gold and page-gold physical pages; nine grid targets and one form target, five page annotations.
parser-comparison.page_score_policy: Existing page gold uses parser-local IDs: report raw score_order values for transparency and a separate deterministic geometric alignment score. One-to-one same-type highest-IoU matching with threshold 0.20, ties by native iteration order; no content or gold-order optimization. Context headings outside the converted page are unavailable and section misses remain misses.

criteria: Catch every gold-table page where VLM data-cell accuracy is strictly greater than corpus_fast in parser comparison, plus forge68-rotated-daily-report and ak3-daily-operations; also report the >=0.10 improvement subset separately.
Selected pages <= 15% of the full measured portfolio.
hard-page-selection.missing_confidence: Null does not trigger low-score tests; no imputation.

rules.expression: rotation != 0 OR landscape OR mode == ocr OR largest_table_share >= 0.60 OR empty_columns >= 3 OR table_score < 0.50 OR form_pairs >= 8
rotation != 0 OR mode == ocr OR (landscape AND form_pairs >= 4) OR largest_table_share >= 0.80 OR empty_columns >= 5 OR table_score < 0.35 OR form_pairs >= 12
rotation != 0 OR (mode == ocr AND form_pairs >= 4) OR (form_pairs >= 8 AND largest_table_share >= 0.35) OR (empty_columns >= 3 AND largest_table_share >= 0.50) OR table_score < 0.20

hard-page-selection.form_signal: Count native text or table-cell strings ending in colon with a nonempty native text/cell value to the right (<=180pt, vertical overlap) or below (<=30pt, horizontal overlap). Distinct label anchors count once. Inline label:value strings also count if label <=80 characters. Geometry from native cells/items; no parser output used as draft gold.
hard-page-selection.false_positive_sample: For each rule, choose up to five selected non-required pages in doc_id/page order; inspect source render and describe why selection may be unnecessary, without claiming confirmed false positives.
clarification_log: Before any VLM conversion or hard-page selection rule selection, the required-page wording was corrected to all positive cell-accuracy wins; the captured >=0.10 wording incorrectly conflated the parser comparison routing-type report with the hard-page selection acceptance criterion. Signals were already computed but selection outcomes and VLM scores were not examined. Rule formulas are unchanged.

criteria: Flag the retained forge68-rotated-daily-report invented Theorem 1.2 sentence.
On visually reviewed correct parser comparison VLM pages, falsely flag <= 0.10 of pages; if no correct-page cohort exists report not evaluable.
text-support.normalization: Use existing ingestion.evaluation.tokens: case-folded alphanumeric token set after whitespace-between-digits collapse; token occurrence support also reported.
text-support.correct_page_definition: Visual review finds no material addition, omission, number/identifier substitution, row/cell or reading-order error. Typography normalization alone is allowed. Review labels fixed before threshold effects are inspected.
text-support.scan_policy: If no PDF text layer, report agreement with corpus OCR text only; do not accept/reject scans.
text-support.historical_positive_control: Retained study forge68-rotated-daily-report Docling VLM output is included explicitly as a positive control even if the Q8 rerun does not invent the same sentence.

form-pairing.criterion: Pair accuracy >=0.90 on each development and each held-out form; zero invented values; bbox coverage 100%. Report per-form and micro/macro aggregates.
form-pairing.generic: Labels are geometric runs ending in colon; no lexicon. Values right on same baseline until next label, vertical ruling or cell edge; wrapped/below text inside same ruled cell. Empty values retained.
form-pairing.template: Same geometry, with label vocabulary and per-label direction learned only from three development forms. Cost-column headings point down the column; Actual includes totals, AFE headings stop before totals. No stored gold values or absolute field regions.
form-pairing.source: PDFium glyphs with coordinates and vector path rulings; respect source clipping paths. Rotate 270-degree physical pages upright for pairing, return boxes in displayed physical frame.
form-pairing.scope: Digital daily-report header strictly before visible Operations Summary; unsupported if boundary absent.
form-pairing.normalization: Original visible glyphs only, source spaces; no spelling, punctuation or value repair.
form-pairing.scorer: experiments/form pairing/score.py unchanged; report literal invention flags and source semantic review.
form-pairing.freeze: Code, shared source reader, template and registration hash-locked before any held-out page selection; no post-lock fixes.

development_refinement.basis: Development score inspection only; held-out selection not started
development_refinement.changes: Split alphabetic label:Value into separate source words at colon; cost-column boundaries from row below heading; Totals direction extends through the following ruled value cell.

scanned-page-ocr.status: registered before candidate generation; annotations inaccessible
criteria: Choose lowest CER, prioritizing numeric and technical critical-token accuracy; elapsed time is secondary.
scanned-page-ocr.scorer: CER and WER use Levenshtein distance after whitespace-only collapse and strip; case/punctuation preserved. Corpus-micro rates divide summed edits by summed reference characters/words. Critical-token accuracy is exact normalized-whitespace substring presence per listed token, case preserved. Also report numeric/technical tokens separately when the manifest supplies categories. Rank critical-token accuracy descending then CER ascending; time only breaks equal accuracy. Missing/failed outputs remain missing, never empty successful transcriptions. All outputs unscored this round.
